notes.title: Fata Deum | Patch 0.1.4 | Out Now
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/d053f1ebca698ccd6a320718a621b4affd79eda2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Patch 0.1.4 is live![/h1][p][/p][p]First of all, THANK YOU for all the good feeback that we received on the beta branch it means a lot to us! We’re excited to roll out these changes now for everyone. This update is a first glimpse at the direction we want [i]Fata Deum[/i] to take during Early Access – faster, freer, and more divine. Everything here is based directly on your feedback – thank you for helping us shape the game![/p][p][/p][p]📢[b]Main goals of this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Unleash divine power[/b]: We’re removing restrictions to give players more freedom and a stronger “god” feel. This includes the multi-grab allowing you to migrate mortals to other cities, pick up bigger piles of resources (while just holding left mouse) and improved/increased throwing physics to come with more punch![/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//38910396/e772f599264bf4d573f79c19378409478b809ee8.gif"][/img]    [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]End the night’s limitations[/b]: You decide what and when to do – gods don’t rest when the sun goes down. All actions that are available during the day are now also available at night.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//38910396/0875ca4cba17032ec591e924f3c76f98f158719b.gif"][/img] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduce micro management:[/b] Quicker and more powerful multicast improving cast time and power of effect[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//38910396/79cd0c0779fa4f92c94dc6b83c1c224e74d19f67.gif"][/img]  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Quicker Building times:[/b] a new building won't wait for the next day to be build anymore allowing the player to have quicker impact and less forced micro-management.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fairer AI:[/b] we decreased the "last hit" power of AI gods that received additional mana when having 0 followers as a "hail mary" which felt unfair to players[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improve Stability and Performance:[/b] we focused a lot on stability and performance improvements over the last week to make Fata deum more stable and improve the player experience - there is more to come soon though![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Patchnotes 0.1.4:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]reduced "last hit power" of AI (AI gets some extra mana when having 0 follower for a final push),[/p][/*][*][p]bug fix where settlements under free will always switch to exhausting workload,[/p][/*][*][p]mortals are now assigned to a building when dropped in the building area / circle no need to select the building directly anymore,[/p][/*][*][p]working mortals stay most of the time now at their work place and have less breaks = easier to find and bless them,[/p][/*][*][p]free the night: all actions possible at daytime are now possible at night too, you can also pause and speed-up time during the night (but still possible to skip of course),[/p][/*][*][p]migration via drag and drop: migration from one settlement to another can now easily be done via multi-drag/collect and drop: just place them at the main building of another settlement,[/p][/*][*][p]two mortals directly start constructing a new building when built during the day,[/p][/*][*][p]increased population limit per settlement,[/p][/*][*][p]updated tutorials for migration, night time handling and speedup and pausing time,[/p][/*][*][p]speedy collect / drag and drop: just hold the left mouse button while collecting,[/p][/*][*][p]increased amount of resources and mortals players can collect [/p][/*][*][p]general speed up of all imp hand interactions,[/p][/*][*][p]more power / speed on physics while throwing[/p][/*][*][p]decreased AI difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]reduced cast bolt effect as becoming to large on higher levels[/p][/*][*][p]Grabbed objects do not disappear in the night and are are saved and still grabbed after loading a savegame[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance and stability[/p][/*][*][p]improved damage logic for godly fist: no more extra damage when directly hitting the ground[/p][/*][*][p]removed doubled power entries in tooltip when leveling up[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]These are just the first steps toward the [i]Fata Deum[/i] we envision. Please keep sharing your feedback – it’s shaping the future of the game![/p]

notes.title: Fata Deum | Patch 0.1.3 | Now Available on the Beta Branch
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c0d1348877e3529d09b0a6f88391e90da5a65e96.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The (Community) Gods have spoken! Please keep in mind that it’s only been 4 days since launch, and we are still gathering and evaluating all of your feedback. [/p][p][/p][p]📢[b]Three of the most frequently mentioned issues were:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Players don't feel free and powerful enough as a god[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The day/night cycle feeling too limiting, especially at night, leaving you powerless as a god/player[/p][/*][*][p]The repetitive use of wonders, which felt too micro-heavy [/p][/*][/list][p]While these are definitely major points that we will rework more deeply in the future, we want to roll out some adjustments right away to already make things feel a bit smoother: [/p][p]⚠️[b]WARNING[/b]: Please understand that quick changes to bigger systems can always break other stuff - we decided to let you choose if want you want to be a part of that early feature testing. If not please remain in the Default version and wait until the systems are more properly tested and ironed out).[/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ [b]Main topics for Patch v0.1.3 [/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Multigrab for Followers: [/b]A god shoudn't have to pick followers one by one. He should be able to carry plenty of them. Well, let's do that![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e772f599264bf4d573f79c19378409478b809ee8.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Nighttime Wonders/Free the Night:[/b] You can now use wonders during the night – whether boosting your villagers or grilling enemies, your divine powers never sleep. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/0875ca4cba17032ec591e924f3c76f98f158719b.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Multicast:[/b] Now easier to use/target and comes with more impact, so you’re less forced to cast wonders on mortals one by one. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/79cd0c0779fa4f92c94dc6b83c1c224e74d19f67.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]These are only the first steps, showing the direction we want to take. We’ll share more soon about upcoming ideas to make you feel more powerful and free as a god. [/p][p][/p][p]⚠️[b]ATTENTION[/b]: Please keep in mind, these changes come with risks, there wille be some bugs at night and definetely balance issues for a bit  now. We will carefully watch, fix and balance based on your reports. What we need is your feedback letting us know if you like these ideas and your bug reports via F2 to polish them up if you enjoy them![/p][p][/p][p][i]Please share your feedback regarding the update/direction and if you want to support the development write us an honest Steam review - Thank you![/i][/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️[b]Full Patch notes[/b] [b]for Patch v0.1.3:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Changes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Now multiple mortals can be grabbed simultaneously[/p][/*][*][p]Improved multicast handling: easier to execute close to mortals and can now be used in an area if hovering over a building like temple too [/p][/*][*][p]More powerful multicast: cost a little bit more mana, but damage is not so strongly reduced if multiple targets are given => much stronger than single targeting [/p][/*][*][p]Free the night: all wonder are executable at night, too. Collecting and dropping is now possible too [/p][/*][*][p]reduced cast bolt effect as becoming to large on higher levels[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Removed migration feature for now: with the multi grab being alive we are already working on realizing migration via multigrabbing and dropping (pick up people and move them to another city - does [b]NOT WORK YET[/b])[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Grabbed objects do not disappear in the night and are are saved and still grabbed after loading a savegame[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔑 [b]How to access the Beta Branch:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Open your [b]Steam Library[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Right-click on [b]Fata Deum[/b] → [b]Properties[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Go to the [b]Betas[/b] tab[/p][/*][*][p]Select [b]Open - Beta[/b] from the dropdown menu[/p][/*][*][p]Close the window – Steam will now automatically download the Beta version[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p]

notes.title: Fata Deum | First Patch | Available In Beta Branch!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/1f68a72bbba9e7ecd3ce78fdffe6f076b18ae257.png"][/img][/p][p]First of all a big THANK YOU for all the massive Feedback and Support that we received - it showcases how passonate you all are about the god game genre. We know that Fata Deum didn't meet everyone's expectation yet and are gathering all the feedback, balancing it internally and will shape Fata Deum towards the God Game that we are all looking for together with you![/p][p]We’re happy to announce that the first patch for Fata Deum is now available in the Beta Branch! [/p][p]To make sure every update works as smooth as possible for every player we provide the new updates on a specific beta branch first. You can decide to hop onto it or remain on the Default branch that will receive the update as soon as we get the feedback that the beta branch is good and stable.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]📢[b]Update Approach:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Beta Branch release first[/b] – you can test new changes and provide feedback via the Beta Branch[/p][/*][*][p][b]Default Branch release afterwards [/b]– once we confirm everything works, the update will go live for all players in the default branch[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weekly patches/updates[/b] – we aim to improve Fata Deum regularly, incorporating your feedback as quickly as possible. In the beginning that means definitely at least (!) weekly patches/fixes. Later when we pick bigger topics it will potentially slow down but increase in depth.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]The first patch brings several important fixes that we were able to adress quickly. Of course for the future we have way bigger updates in mind that will incorporate more of your ideas and add more value to the playing experience. Here’s the changelog:[/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ [b]Patch Notes v0.1 (Beta)[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted sound design for mortal reactions, lowered voices[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed some widescreen issues were menus would clip out of screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed re-appearing broken throwable objects after loading a game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug were newGame was impossible if certain savegames were deleted[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug were some dialogs (god comments) briefly showed richtext[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution setting should not reset itself anymore[/p][/*][*][p]Moved some descriptions in Skill tooltips, making the tooltip less wide, lessening out of screen clipping[/p][/*][*][p]Further remark to make clear that free will / no action manipulation is a change button not a status quo[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔑 [b]How to access the Beta Branch:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Open your [b]Steam Library[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Right-click on [b]Fata Deum[/b] → [b]Properties[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Go to the [b]Betas[/b] tab[/p][/*][*][p]Select [b]Open - Beta[/b] from the dropdown menu[/p][/*][*][p]Close the window – Steam will now automatically download the Beta version[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]We’re excited to hear more of your feedback! Be assured that we work hard on new Patches and Updates to adapt your feedback as soon as possible. Please let us know which improvements you’d like to see in future updates.[/p][p]Thank you for shaping [i]Fata Deum[/i] together with us. 💙[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Fata Deum | Release Dev Update | Out on September 15!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/19a6874af32ca9a81ae1d31cdc766e7666bed907.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We are proud to announce that Fata Deum will be entering Early Access on 15 September. Since our last development update, we have been focusing on improving the gameplay experience, optimising details and fixing bugs to give you the best possible experience from day one! [/p][p][/p][p]Although we said last time that we would not be adding any more features to the game and would instead focus solely on optimisation and polishing, we have to admit that we have added a few features here and there...[/p][p][/p][p][u]Here is a summary what happened since March:[/u][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved god spheres[/p][/*][*][p]Improved VFX wonders effects[/p][/*][*][p]Improved wonder protection[/p][/*][*][p]New wonders[/p][/*][*][p]One shot wonders[/p][/*][*][p]Overview map update[/p][/*][*][p]Settlement overview[/p][/*][*][p]Anti aliasing / upscaling [/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fata Deum artbook[/p][/*][*][p]Fata Deum soundtrack[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c17f5562078683247eebe13c226294470fc9e7fc.png"][/img][/p][p]First of all, we reworked the god's appearances. Our four deities Fertility, Pleasure, Deceit, Violence and the player now have a more unique and enhanced look. Take a closer look. [/p][p align="center"][/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/f13a197bb857ce7421dcb3107b038c40e94e61d1.png"][/img][/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/d0ee4a933c77a1c61658837588b639a1601565d1.png"][/img][/p][p]All wonders now have unique VFX effects and are more noticeable when they are executed by you or an enemy deity. Here is a sneak peak on the empower and divert effect.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a84950a3ae0f489f975aa7d680f55222050458ee.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/cabf6056728b3e8d0de91ac8c1bd47b9d3521523.png"][/img][/p][p]We adjusted the function of “Wonder protection”. Every mortal and building can be protected against wonder, which works as a shield which needs to be destroyed before damage can be inflicted to the target by a wonder.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4d8675b593200da049f6df1b11858abfbc0fb4ad.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The wonder protection altar can now protect mortals and buildings from getting damaged. It creates a protection sphere, even if the mortal or building has no protection. [/p][p][/p][p]Settlements close to your god sphere are automatically protected.[/p][p] [/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4354b3145b3ec59683e15ba6263185de0f72889e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e6c5fad8dbc750e90b42fb155a2fb27db639bb34.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition to the reworked VFX effects, we added six new wonders into the game (yes, we said we wouldn't add any more new content, but we just couldn't resist!). Grow trees, make mortals dance, speed up the building process, capture them, protect them, or destroy an entire village!  [/p][p][/p][p][u]Miraculous Fertility:[/u][/p][p][/p][p]You don`t have to die to get to paradise as long as you have a garden. 
Felled all trees around your village to construct buildings? No worries, use “Miraculous Fertility" and let new trees grow within seconds.    [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/0f12f0d43f9ab7ce9db35642ca7ab335ac441faf.gif"][/img] [/p][p][u]Dance Fever:[/u][/p][p][/p][p]Dance the night away! Bored to see hard working mortals? Slow down productivity by using “Dance Fever” to distract them and push their energy. Or just end fighting and let them all dance! [/p][p][/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/2da903d5b267a2035a2b85af6adda68ca4dc70ad.gif"][/img][/p][p][u]Building Boost:[/u][/p][p][/p][p]The end of shortage of skilled workers. Build buildings faster or repair damaged ones, your choice![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e018a7f6ea9d5e91db1880005690945ac1baaaf6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][u]Protection Stasis:[/u][/p][p][/p][p]Immortality lasts the longest. Protect your favorite mortals by freezing them in stasis. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/47412eab16e388ff06f2d2bceb23c4840f495302.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/6afa522c2f7ebfe62f51e7fa9675d3b524c60367.png"][/img] Besides earning skills from the skill tree, you are now able to earn one shot wonders. But execute wisely, you will only have one shot to make the perfect use of it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a6babbbc20c8c7f07d8cac4dfcc3b9e16940bb1c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/564f37d389448b99cdb729182cc7280e0a9d8b8c.png"][/img][/p][p]We enhanced the functions of the overview map. You are now able to see the paths between the villages and cities. We added the view menu to the overview map too. Select an icon from it and you will see it appear above village icons to show you the statistics. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4ffb2ef1c183e7897472596ae67f26ad8433d89a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/b47ea201b2939f06bcc0424f42fb22dd9e5bd320.png"][/img][/p][p]We added more icons to the settlement UI, to make it easier for you to manage your village. Furthermore, you will now see incoming and outcoming trades, energy gains and losses and how much resources are produced by mortals per day. [/p][p] [/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/72da017904e6bac3781c1706951735c27613965c.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/1b43af6ae205661c7c203af92459dde9289843de.png"][/img]We added Anti Aliasing to the game. It calculates the game in a lower resolution and afterwards, the image is enhanced with a better frame rate and performance. We will support DLSS and FSR with multiple quality levels.[/p][p]
[/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/47b00e410c12cb45eddcbe77135d0fd28275ac92.png"][/img][/p][p]We kept working hard to improve the performance of the game and can proudly say that with our minimum requirements, you should be able to play the game at 30 fps. With high spec PC`s you can target 60fps and more.[/p][p]
[/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/092eeb9ea5ed183f35d1c32391b7b159691f7d62.png"][/img][/p][p]Together with the game, we will release an artbook and a soundtrack. Keep an eye out on our store page on release to find them. Here is a small sneak peek from our artbook. Choose between [b]four enemy deities[/b]: Fertility, Violence, Deceit or Pleasure. You want to play in peace? Depending on your decisions the world will react, so choose wisely![/p][p] [/p][p]Our[b] advanced physics-based destruction system[/b] helps to demolish or destroy buildings with your godly powers. [b]Grab and throw[/b] them around with the Godly Hand. [/p][p][/p][p]Choose from over [b]30 different wonders[/b] (good and evil ones) and shape the world according to your will![/p][p] [/p][p]Use our free building with drag and drop mechanisms and [b]20+ building types[/b] to expand your villages and cities.[/p][p] [/p][p]Take some time to explore some of our [b]56 locations[/b]. Some have quests, others offer rewards. Will you be able to find them all?[/p][p][/p][p]While playing, you can choose[b] different skills[/b] with two different subsets of daytime and nighttime powers, making [b]every playthrough unique[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]The Fates will introduce themselves to you, offering [b]8 Fate Challenges[/b] with one challenge from each Fate. Through these you will unlock new difficulties, islands, start progressions and special game set ups.  [/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/de409bd209be5fa984bdc318bcc16a5e8f751e37.png"][/img] [/p][p]We can`t wait for you to hop on the game on the 15 September![/p][p][/p][p]And there is even more for you coming soon.[/p][p] [/p][p]We will continue implementing your feedback, and are already aiming to implement new buildings, wonders and quests. [/p][p]Fata Deum Dev Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update March 2025: Game Setup, Fate Challenges, Improved Buildings,....
notes.notes:
Since October we`ve been working hard and are proud to present our progress.

[u][i][b]Here is a quick summary:[/b][/i][/u]
[list]
[*] Game Setup + Meta Progession 
[*] Intro Cutscene + Fate Challenges
[*] Voice Over
[*] Quests & Rewards
[*] Improved Village Buildings 
[*] Animation Varience
[*] Advanced Demolition System
[*] Wonder Load Status Icon
[*] Mortal Motivation
[*] Steam Rewards

[/list][hr][/hr][h3]New Game Setup Menu & Meta Progression
[/h3]

When starting a new game, you now have the opportunity to specify your game setup. 

On which island do you want to play? 
Which enemy gods do you want to go up against? 
How difficult should it be and what should your start progress look like?

[u][i]Specials:[/i][/u] If you want to go crazy, choose a special game setup. 

Normal mortals do not fly high enough when you hit them? Smash them into space with our [i][b]“Lunar Gravity”[/b][/i]. 

You want to start a zombie apocalypse? Go for it with the [i][b]“Night of the living dead”[/b][/i] special. 

Or do you want to have an advanced start with a lot of villages or fully build cities? Then start with the [i][b]“Advanced Villages”[/b][/i] or [i][b]“Cities”[/b][/i] special.

But not all options are available from the beginning and you need to unlock these due to several challenges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/fed113d25963088389d0b77fac04130fab537fda.png[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Intro Cutscene & Fate Challenges[/h3]

Each Free Play will start with a great intro cutscene introducing your creators: The Fates. 

They will not only guide you and tell you more about the world. From time to time they will reach out and will give you the opportunity to choose between 3 challenges. 

So you can choose your fate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/5b36ff1e1f4438ad9c1094008aaa0633d5eb5259.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/998ee1a87d1a1a3e5a7c2da629c326d72acddc89.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e2ecadd329a9d48c7e4ba7c47e538201ae95ed93.png[/img]

Once a challenge is fulfilled the corresponding Fate blesses you and increases your already growing powers!

[hr][/hr][h3]Voice Over [/h3]

Yes, that’s right! The intro cutscene and the Imp (the whole tutorial!) are talking!

[hr][/hr][h3]Quests and Rewards[/h3]

All of our islands are now filled with exploration spots. Fly around the island and visit them. In some cases you find interesting quests, in others you will earn a reward for exploring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/343317792fbcb3f74660b7f8c54eb32f94dda5eb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/ad7b7cdf0d562932b689bcaba6ec800d193a9f79.png[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Improved Buildings[/h3]

We enhanced our village building assets to give a better look. Here are beauty shots from three of them. 

[i][u]School:[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/2e973d5198bb397dd8f1c6660c37d51244858e63.gif[/img]

[i][u]Temple:[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/b952b0eafc8d2455208f77c0cba8d1858ee4af0c.gif[/img]

[i][u]Barrack:[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a58bb50735c29a0e3d5a3c9d76bfb2f36d168ffb.gif[/img]

And these are just a few out of 11 village buildings we have improved.

[hr][/hr][h3] Animation Variation [/h3]

Along with the improved building assets, buildings are now bustling and there are a variety of animations. For example, you can now see people drinking, trading, dancing, or sleeping at the tavern. Take a closer look at each building and you will see many different things going on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c922500a020253fecc7fa7fb99c17bf24f2cddf7.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Advanced Demolition System[/h3]

With our newly added decal and the deformation, the meteor strike looks even more devastating.  Each building can be deformed in a very realistic and/or funny way! 

This can also be done with the Godly Fist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/68bab5591fd31d852e0729502188687e4d8b066c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/b5aedb9a006e1e2147fa5f68d7dccf124918b253.gif[/img]

Afterwards the mortals rush to the building and try to repair it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/beed785092cf4c922597edd749fb59ffb2a0dc92.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Wonder Load Icon[/h3]

Often it was not obvious how powerful your wonder was when you held the mouse for longer. This has now changed with our wonder load icon. You are now able to see exactly which wonder level you execute the longer you hold it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/00a56310441933cf39e23d1f02e05df45cb8c9cd.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Mortal Motivation[/h3]

Are your mortals lazy or do they lack motivation? Spread fear, punish one mortal and others will be motivated as they fear to be punished, too! So it is even better now to be evil!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/71351f4cc878260829bc89a08dd0cf82b226c23c.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Steam Rewards[/h3]

Earn steam rewards by playing Fata Deum. Collect up to 8 trading cards, craft badges, earn background images for your steam account, or unlock emoticons to chat with other gods. Here is a small sample of what you will be able to earn. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4255af18dddd75f03ce30fa25b834d78ff4d150c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a1c17e409f2afed3c476ef42618adca6f5609b7b.png[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Next Steps[/h3]

We have now stopped developing any new features and focus on polishing and bug fixing to provide you a smooth experience from day one!

notes.title: Dev Update October 2024: Free Building, Advanced Physics, Mortal Reactions,....
notes.notes:
For those of you eager for a [i]god game[/i] that offers genuine creative control, this update is exactly what you’ve been asking for. After sharing our demo at Steam NextFest, we took in a lot of your feedback. The key takeaway? 

You want more freedom, interaction, and a world that reacts to your influence. We’ve taken your feedback to heart and implemented various substantial changes to give you just that.

So we checked our timetable again, reprioritized, squeezed additional budget out of our great publisher, and went back to work!

[u][i]And this is what we have delivered:[/i][/u]
[list]
[*] Free building 
[*] Advanced physics
[*] Damage resources to extract stones
[*] Throw items like stones, gold nuggets and trees
[*] Grab and plant trees 
[*] Advanced mortal reaction system
[*] Cutscene sneak peek
[*] Quests
[*] Tutorial Manager
[/list][hr][/hr][h3]Free Building
[/h3]
Build the way you want with our new free building system. 

You can start building by choosing a building from the shortcut menu and a nice location. Hold the left mouse button to rotate the building. 

Does your desired building already exist? Then, you can drag and drop the building! 

The road is created automatically, so you do not have to bother yourself with such micromanagement stuff if you do not want to!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/7781ab532cef051150c49502a96e90127cb66fb5.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Advanced Physics[/h3]

We further advanced the physics of the game. You can now damage resources to get throwable items. These items can be used to damage buildings or crush mortals. The choice is up to you. If your throw is good enough, you may achieve both. 

But you can also collect the resource nuggets and send them as a gift (boring!).

[code]               [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/35fd261001c022509b9e799908041584760e63e0.gif[/img]

               [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/170c094891dba54584437601b7e069b8e00d3e15.gif[/img][/code]
Is your village missing some trees, or does a tree just bother you? No worries. Grab the tree, look for another place that suits him, and place him there. The mortals will be happy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/3f918faf2dd3a060a631c7e599e34479c2e7c454.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Advanced Mortal Reaction System[/h3]

You are a god. Everything you do influences the world. And so does the reaction of the mortals. Do something good, and they will cheer. Do something bad, and they will be scared.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e07a54a22a1b10b77038fc719c2cb2f56dc9a942.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c5ddcc668f32d8631b2e5c33b6db2ec2ed311e12.gif[/img]
[code]               [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/1d94956f438e508a93b98a365f918dad8af42b3b.gif[/img][/code]
[hr][/hr][h3]Cutscene [/h3]

The narrative of Fata Deum will be told via special cutscenes and in-game quest scenes. 
Just take a look 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/48dd511a1d96093d32e837deea168bba2d631ed2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/05dd46a3a58f8f276027c6813225fe13ef1b7822.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][h3]Quests[/h3]

A first round of quests is now implemented. As we continue developing, more quests will enter the game. There will be many ways to accomplish a quest. And for those who don't care about them, no worries, you can mostly ignore them, too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/fde8a0beeeb733997001386979f9d074df5154af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/007782b90dedca01e0a3875496c3e46b49a1ed81.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/0edd9e1553ebb125b85f0083f5792376699a0cef.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][h3]Tutorial Manager[/h3]

We have received a lot of feedback from you regarding the tutorial. Some of you wanted to start playing immediately without it; others had the problem that they sometimes missed or skipped it while playing. 

So, we redesigned the tutorial flow to let you decide how and when to proceed.

With every new ability you learn, you will be asked if you want to do a tutorial or not instead of just pushing you to do it. Furthermore, we added three new tutorial buttons: “Pause”; “Skip”; “Go Back”. You can use these to watch the last sentence again, pause, or skip the tutorial.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c0752e0b87aaac3b6f1f809d1c051836e0c65f0b.png[/img]

Pressing the Imp will open our new tutorial menu. All tutorials in the game are displayed here as soon as you have unlocked them. You now have the freedom to do tutorials whenever you like!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/fed3563345e29bba5361b57e60c5821390ce535c.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Release Date[/h3]

OK, this was a lot, wasn’t it? :) 

And it was worth the effort!

But yes, it takes time..

We want to give you the best experience on day one. Therefore, we will push the release window to 2025 to implement your great feedback and ensure the game is polished.

Thanks again for your patience!

The god game genre will be back in 2025!

notes.title: Dev Update May 2024: Physics, Wonder Reactions, UI.
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, Divine Ones![/h1]
Since April, we’ve been working hard and are proud to present our progress. 

Here is a quick summary:
[list]
[*] Physics
[*] Wonder Reactions
[*] Constitution Wonder
[*] Exploration Spots
[*] UI
[*] Steam Next Fest
[/list][h2]Physics[/h2]
A big thing we added that you guys were waiting for is physics. With it, 2 new abilities made it into the game: grabbing and throwing mortals. Furthermore, the epic wonder Godly Fist allows you to really punish your mortals! With these skills, you can have fun playing with mortals or penalize them when they don't believe in you.

With the grab, you can take a mortal and place him in another building to shift his work focus.

notes.title: Fata Deum Development Update - April 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]Skill Tree, Narrative Design & Mythical Locations[/h1]

Since November, we’ve been working hard and are proud to present our progress. Here is a quick summary:
[list]
[*] Tutorial & Skill Tree
[*] Narrative Design & Mythical Locations
[*] AI Improvements
[*] Improved Fire Effect
[*] Enhanced Sound
[/list]
[h2]Tutorial & Skill Tree[/h2]

Our main focus in the last months has been implementing your tutorial feedback. 

We slimmed down the dialogues and adjusted the pacing. Relevant things will only be explained when they matter. At the same time, the tutorial has new content and is more polished than ever. All this could be accomplished with the help of our new skill system. 

A new skill system? Yes, you heard right. As a part of the tutorial improvement, we implemented a skill tree as a new gameplay feature. You will have much more freedom of what you want to skill/learn and how you would like to develop yourself as a god. 

A new level-up allows you to upgrade a Wonder or Manipulation. The Imp will then shortly introduce you to your newly chosen ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a77587e72161cec8c17a94e0fd2ec3f2e7010107.jpg[/img]
The more you level up, the more skills you can learn. All skills have multiple levels, which can make them even more powerful.

We also reworked the player skill UI to be more clearly arranged and readable. Here, you can see all of your already unlocked skills and their effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a7ac4e63304d67e35959748004187006ede0d809.jpg[/img]
[h2]Narrative Design & Mythical Locations[/h2]

Our narrative team started working on story-driven quests to provide even more things to explore and experience on each island.

Since then, some strange things appeared. What mysteries could they hold?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/f001289c45255001dfe8c0873b389bb318c728ba.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4942b4b802649e56aa130ba368153cc0583f0895.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/511863860f75054c7e58b605be7397d57bbdddc6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/3f4238d7d4778959ba199acd82c73f4326cb7f88.jpg[/img]
[h2]AI Improvements
[/h2]
We kept working on our AI system. It can now manage cities, including resource chains, building monuments, and upgrading equipment in neighboring villages. Furthermore, it has learned new actions like building outposts and summoning fireworks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e80a12f30584720a38c237eca929f0dc7e8399c9.jpg[/img]
A new type of prayer that appears less frequently gives more Prayer Points but is also more difficult to fulfill. Above all, it leaves more choices about how it is fulfilled, as it simply requires that certain properties fulfill a certain value.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/44bc1333305119fc08a9ebdef153b1cbfb9ecf48.jpg[/img]
[h2]Improved Fire Effect[/h2]

We improved the fire effect to be even more satisfying. Take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/9b36db11714a402da5fd9d9988faaab958093d51.gif[/img]
[h2]Enhanced Sound[/h2]

Prick up your ears. We reworked the sounds to bring you a more immersive experience. We added sound to the UI elements and switched sounds on Demons, Farming, Villages, and Cities to better suit the game. In addition, volume levels have been adjusted, and slight effects such as reverberation have been added for a more harmonious image. 

[h2]Next Steps[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Wonders will find their way to Fata Deum.

[/list]
We’ll let you know when the new demo is ready, and we thank you for your patience so far

notes.title: November 2023 Update: Gameplay Features, UI Changes, AI, New Map, and more!
notes.notes:

notes.title: June 2023 Update: New UI, AI, Levels, Cutscenes, Achievements, …
notes.notes:
Fata Deum has evolved a lot during the last months in several areas:

[list]
[*] Several new UI features have been introduced and the overall UX has been adapted based on the community feedback.
[*] After a long period the new god AI is finally ready and four different AI characters are eagerly waiting to challenge the player.
[*] Another level for three gods has been created with the godly powers of our level designer
[*] Campaign cutscenes have been designed.
[*] 25 achievements can now be achieved.
[*] and much more…
[/list]

[h3]Improved UI[/h3]

We have added three new UI elements, which have been requested by our community. Thanks for the feedback! 

[b]Settlement Overview:[/b] this provides all important details of the current settlement at the top of the screen. Furthermore, it is possible to navigate to the next or previous settlement with one click.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/97697bd40b7b1c6fe10e5ba6eeb7cbe5d062556e.jpg[/img]

[b]The View Menu:[/b] this menu allows you to search for specific attributes in your current surroundings. Looking for mortals with low health to help them to recover (or bring it to an end..)?  Looking for those who follow another god? Need to know who is most productive?The strongest warriors? This is the way to go: just select the corresponding attribute and all important details are directly rendered on top of the surrounding mortals. You can either lock your setup for further investigations or shortly hover over an icon to get a first impression. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4eae57abf06648b02f85be89fb76d6aef4bd19ee.jpg[/img]

[b]The Shortcut Menu:[/b] the shortcut menu provides you direct access to all wonders and available settlements. Thereby, you can easily move from one important part of the current match to another with the click of one button. You can now be everywhere at once, just like a real god!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/f9ef8af778e9b3f95ade9d4c8dc2809a78482877.jpg[/img]

The settlement shortcuts also provide a good overview of the current belief distribution in each settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a7a0bef4c20485ec48ba1a0162a53668a27c064f.jpg[/img]

It is possible to configure the shortcut menu as you like and also mix settlement and wonder shortcuts in one row.

You can add as many configurations as you want and switch between them easily.

You can also create shortcuts for specific positions on the map, not just for settlements.

Being a god has never been so easy!


[b]The New AI[/b]

Our new AI system, which has been in development for a very long time, is now active and ready for a challenge! Four different AI characters (Fertility, Pleasure, Deceit, Violence) act very differently while still being able to react to the player’s behavior.

Do you want to see how your followers are hit by thunder strikes day by day, while a mass of soldiers are trained to conquer your lands? Violence is your choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/f8bcf35e1e96ba0d6e95ca21fb36574ce6c56c50.jpg[/img]

Prefer to see how your followers get cursed and start to attack each other for no reason until a massive horde of zombies takes over your village? Deceit will be your match!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4afaefe65da7a4a3a9f34146ce62113d5f644932.jpg[/img]

Do you want to keep up against inhuman growth and beauty? Seeing villages and cities evolving in no time? Meet up with Fertility! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e2e24be8e260373f0f19619b3abda869d17965d5.jpg[/img]

Or do you just wanna have fun? Pleasure is your opponent!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/567ea5809689439e70dca7d4af8a52858438d6d4.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, each AI character is not only acting individually but will also comment on the player’s action in its own style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c0c5c13a05bd24c1002072f6a0a3326f111c40db.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/9ec60ca9d7e0d8f7b76a8b55edf368eca4b16033.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/159fdad8076d647cc8a71d50c3d04b252cee3b8c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/2106b096d901cfbeae0778a78936e18c1f4e739a.jpg[/img]

So be ready for some rude suggestions, too ;)

We will further improve the AI, especially when it comes to long-term planning and we will also add several difficulty options. And bug fixing, of course!

[b]Another Beautiful Island[/b]

Another map is ready to be conquered, and it is the most beautiful one 🙂

Take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a242a8f6ca610ff37c7737e90aef9b90edf83fd9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/cd66492400fab988bb785c655544c786d52a8936.jpg[/img]

Fata Deum lets the player experience the story of a young god who learns to lead its human followers and to assert itself through them against divine rivals. In a process of increasing challenges, it not only finds out more and more about its opponents, but also about itself.

A first set of 25 achievements are now implemented!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/5fd809144fb419c9805c342ef14dc0218f91be26.png[/img]

We will now take a break and enjoy the (already very hot) summer!
Afterwards we will further focus on UI/UX, AI, performance, and level design. 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: February 2023 update: Levels, Camera, Performance, Audio, and AI
notes.notes:
Hello again! We’re back after another break, this time because we were focused on organizational matters. We’ve hired four additional staff members (three software developers and one level designer). We needed some time to train up and become productive.

And, wow - have we been productive 🙂

[b]Level Design[/b]

Nico, our level designer, first learned how to work with our tools and to understand what is a feature and what is a bug in our very customized level designing toolchain. After some teething issues at the beginning, he's become very productive quite fast.

And below are the first results of a skirmish map for up to four gods:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/9f39a11e4ae3a176dc382b9fd4322fb3298ba235.jpg[/img]
The new four gods map is ready for action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/5689d096c6adf61fce9a618886495ffc7b4e612e.jpg[/img]
Many mortals available! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/b0ba902b7fb9bee6a984a76fbf26f42d7390805a.jpg[/img]
Four gods, four cities (and many more villages) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/50a2b4d3255b1990f3bf063bef93b790a274f7b7.jpg[/img]
Who will succeed?!

While this map still needs some polishing, a second map for up to three gods is already in the making:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/73890657cc8af1fbcea5d564ff8f5800e1aef2e4.jpg[/img]
A three gods map is already in the making!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/1497967d28c192879c422e58d41cdec9b25c612f.jpg[/img]
Nice place for a holiday ?!

The massive amount of buildings and characters being simulated and rendered in the end game of a five gods maps directly highlights the second very important topic we are currently working on:

[b]Performance[/b]

There are several very complex issues if you want to bring a game like Fata Deum to life (large numbers of characters, complex AI logic, many buildings, etc.). Especially, if most of it shall also be visible at a distance. 

One major bottleneck in the end game was the rendering of a large amount of characters. We do not want to bother you with technical details but we needed to test many different techniques and faced many technical issues until we found a solution. This ended up being a combination of several techniques that satisfies our high standards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/21311eba40f577010a4ee11aa0a974a557c75c14.png[/img]
Test scenario: rendering as many diverse characters as possible at the same time!

Geri worked really hard to find this solution and the results are very promising: he was able to push us from 20 FPS in end game situations with a large amount of characters to over 60 FPS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/d71a1fa7499e5a854b2248c042c263ed3d7ef7a7.png[/img]
Before: low frame rate because of many characters rendered at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/ff8606657c2cd215ba5994f150147d1f597ed472.jpg[/img]
After: 60 FPS even many characters are rendered at the same time!

And these are frames captured inside the Unity editor, so performance is even better with a real build!
 
We will proceed to increase the overall performance, so that we will be able to provide you a smooth experience in all cases.

[b]Camera Controls[/b]

The camera controls are the functionality which has been most criticized in the feedback form we have collected from all of you. So, we decided to put Jan on this job to focus on it!

One main issue here is to provide a smooth experience even when switching between different height levels and using different distance and view angles. While many strategy and simulation games have quite fixed camera angles and distances, Fata Deum allows you to move freely. This is great, but makes camera control quite complex.

As the overall complexity has been understood over time and the camera logic was technically a wild-mix of different camera control styles, Jan decided to rewrite the whole logic. While this part is done and we already have a much better experience, Jan will further improve and polish the logic over the next months while working on other tasks. 

Jan also added the functionality for individual key bindings, which can now be defined by each player in the main menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/505cd4777e2fba27a8980eb9952a1cf4c142f901.jpg[/img]
Key bindings!!

[b]Audio Improvements[/b]

There have been some issues on the audio logic which resulted in sounds being played much more often than intended, resulting in a more or less quite annoying gaming experience once the scenery became more crowded. Jakob, another new hire, did fix this at the very beginning. Our ears are very thankful 🙂

[b]Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery[/b]

As we are now working in a much larger team with four software developers in parallel, it was also necessary to improve our workflow on an organizational and a technical level. Jakob implemented a Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery system, which allows us to automatically check the newest builds which are pushed onto the server and receive a fresh new version automatically every night. While setting this up was quite time-intensive, we can now proceed with focusing on our tasks and not having to waste time on time-intensive builds or code checks!

[b]AI Dialogs[/b]   

Jakob has also started work on AI related topics. As the AI is quite complex it will need some time until he can take over this part. One thing he is currently working on is the introduction of AI dialogues, so the AI god character reacts to specific situations, e.g. a simple greeting at the beginning of a match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/7538166dc0faf328ee3cd7c73b8a3b01c093f06b.jpg[/img]
God Deceit speaks his first words!

[b]Next Steps[/b]

We are planning to provide you with new updates every couple of months or so. In terms of what the team will be working on next:

[list]
[*] Nico will continue on creating new maps and improving the vegetation visually.
[*] Jan will further improve the camera logic and furthermore improve the UI.
[*] Geri will continue with improving performance.
[*] Jakob will focus on AI mostly.
[/list]
Chris was mainly focusing on supporting all others with their tasks and bug fixing whatever stands in their way. But he hopes to continue working on AI across the next few months. 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Development Update: Release Schedule, Steam Next Fest and AI
notes.notes:
We are sorry for being silent over the last months, but after the very intense time at the begin of the year (publisher deal and Steam Next Fest), we decided to calm down a bit, check the feedback, take a breath, check the feedback again, talk to our brand-new publisher, sit back, check the feedback again, do some planning, talk to the publisher and continue to work 😊

Based on the feedback and the possibility to get access to additional budget (via our publisher) we decided that increasing the team size, especially for software development, would be the best step for the project.

To achieve this, we needed to change things organizational and code-wise. So currently we are still in this transformational process while improving the AI in the meantime (code-aspects are really high-priority right now).

As AI improvements or the mentioned organizational aspects are quite difficult to demonstrate via an update, we have not much to share right now, sorry!

But things are going very well for Fata Deum and the mentioned steps will results in an improved development speed during this year and also allows us to already have much better support at the begin of the EA phase (instead of ramping these things up after getting new budget during the EA release).

So, it is very great that our publisher supports us in this direction!

The Steam Next Fest has been a great success and we received a lot of new input (2000+ filled out queries…) so this needed time 😊 

The cooperation with the publisher means more money and more quality for Fata Deum before we release to EA, but it also means: a later release! 

Thereby, we decided to move the release date to 2023. 
A good god game needs time!

[b]Steam Next Fest Was a Great Success![/b]

Over 25.000 gamer played the Fata Deum demo and over 2.000 feedback forms have been filled out!
We have been able to more than double our Steam wishlists count and have now more than 100.000 outstanding wishlists (still increasing day by day). For an indie developer these wishlists numbers are very important to get enough coverage by Steam during release. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/134a032e3f9c94d1c7f70f1f1f14df2a59fc4f83.png[/img]
We have more than doubled our wishlist numbers during the Steam Next Fest! (https://steamdb.info/app/1330360/graphs/)

Having 100.000 wishlists is a great success for a small indie team like us and this would not have been possible without your support.

Thank you so much! 

Our publisher Hooded Horse did also a great job during the Steam Next Fest so we could reach a new level of visibility. We are now on position 132 in the Steam global wishlists charts. Considering that more than 10.000 games are launched at Steam every year, this is just amazing!

[b]Feedback Evaluation[/b]
2.000 filled out feedback forms during the Steam Next Fest… that’s a lot 😊 
And we have taken them seriously analyzing each of these feedbacks!

While the overall picture is already quite good, we still have issues with controls and the tutorials ☹
So, this is something we will add another iteration for!
We also received a lot of nice ideas we will would like to put in the game either before or after EA release! 

Of course, we would love to read that everyone is already totally happy with the game and ship it, but we are willing to get the mentioned issues fixed and ship afterwards!

That is what feedback is for😊 And our publisher sees things very similar.

[b]Next Steps[/b]

We will now take a break (summer holidays) and continue to work afterwards! Next available Alpha build will be the big AI patch! So, stay tuned! A real godly opponent will kick your ass soon 😉 (this brand-new experience will only be available for Kickstarter Alpha backers, sorry)

notes.title: New Alpha Release: Characters, UI and Ancient Relics
notes.notes:
After a longer development we are very happy to deliver a huge set of new features! New Characters, new UI, ancient relics and many more!

We are very happy with the progress, but to get this game great (for Early Access) [b]we need to move the release date to Q3 2021[/b] (more details [b]under section Further Development[/b] of this update). Quality first!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/47ca048918d543eae19926a3563bbc71ffe79d0c.jpg[/img]  

[h2]Further Development[/h2]
We are very happy with the current progress, but we will definitely not be able to release the game in April. We believe that some additional months will be very good for the game and the community in terms of quality and fun!

Looking at the necessary steps to achieve the wanted level of quality and quantity we decided to only provide a rough estimation of the upcoming release date and move it to somewhere in Q3 2021.
If we come closer to the third quarter, we will provide an update on this deadline, of course.

During the last weeks we received very positive feedback from our backers regarding the question “Shall we take more time for the sake of quality?” and thereby we look very confident into the future! 
Thanks for the great support!

Our next steps will be to improve out tutorials for the game and provide a public demo.
Afterwards we would like to add a second level and improve the AI!

Stay tuned!

Cheers

Chris
